summary: Lufax Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on October 7, 2026, furnishing a monthly return to The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited. The return is a routine listing compliance disclosure covering movements in securities for the month, including equity issuer and Hong Kong Depositary Receipt details, with no transaction terms, board recommendations, or special-situation elements. The registrant acts solely as filer. No deal mechanics, risk-arb angle, or regulatory clock applies.
